faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about FluxAI Studio

faqs.question: How do I get started with FluxAI Studio?
faqs.answer: Simply sign up for a free account, choose your plan, and start creating! Our intuitive interface lets you generate your first AI image within minutes.

faqs.question: What image formats and resolutions are supported?
faqs.answer: We support PNG and JPG formats with resolutions from 512x512 up to 4K (4096x4096), depending on your plan. All images are generated in high quality with commercial usage rights included.

faqs.question: Can I use the generated images commercially?
faqs.answer: Yes! All plans include commercial usage rights. You can use generated images for business, marketing, products, or any commercial purpose without additional licensing fees.

faqs.question: How fast is image generation?
faqs.answer: Most images are generated within 10 seconds. Pro and Studio users get priority queue access for even faster generation times.

faqs.question: What makes Flux models special?
faqs.answer: Flux models are state-of-the-art AI systems that excel at understanding complex prompts, generating photorealistic details, and maintaining consistency across different styles and subjects.
